name: packy-onexmodel-provider-integration
title: 接入 PackyAPI 与 OneXModel 多平台模型、用量及余额管理
description: Plan PackyAPI and OneXModel text-provider adapters, Admin/CLI model publication, Frontend dispatch, unified ops.llm_calls usage/cost reconciliation and account balance probes. Implementation authorized on 2026-11-24.
creator: codex
notes: 2026-11-24: Local adapter implementation and read-only upstream diagnosis complete. OneX official endpoint plus opt-in local proxy returns 9 models; Packy authorized Key group has no models and needs account-owner resource/group correction. User waived local UI testing. Remote schema/migrations, paid end-to-end billing acceptance, deployment and P95 remain pending; no commit/push/production publication.

measurement.source: Existing Frontend/Faro readiness and Backend Pino request duration, separated by Android/iOS, environment, version and provider. No visible real baseline samples collected.
measurement.window: Separate continuous 24-hour windows before and after release; record N for each cohort. Insufficient samples remain explicitly unverified.

mobile_performance.notes: All baselines are null because no real samples are visible. Targets are planned ceilings, not measured claims. Android and iOS require separate verification. Generation first-text timing follows the existing shared deadline separately from the model-config GET. No management or directory I/O on the generation hot path; no mandatory fixed-sample local performance gate.

scope: New provider directories and Admin/CLI configuration consumers
Generation dispatch and usage terminal paths
Unified call ledger and bounded cost reconciliation jobs
Admin account balance and existing monitor worker
integration_points: platform/observability/fetch.ts clientFetch and existing HTTP terminal observation
Existing generation dispatch/settle/call-ledger and repository observations
Existing Publisher/outbox dedupe and failure isolation
failure_paths: Directory missing credentials, wrong group, empty/invalid JSON, HTML 403, 429 and timeout retain explicit error or stale state
Pre-stream errors, interrupted stream, missing usage, cancellation and race loser retain one terminal observation without duplicate POST
Ledger failure, unknown units, late/duplicate/ambiguous invoices, lost leases and exhausted retries do not alter user billing
Account auth/probe failure or missing policy is skipped/partial and never zero balance or healthy recovery
logging_integration.correlation: Reuse HTTP ALS request_id/trace_id/span_id plus history/attempt/call identity; Admin actor comes from server authentication. Cost and monitor rounds create isolated job roots, with per-call scopes and database leases. High-cardinality identifiers are not metric or Sentry labels.
logging_integration.redaction: Only allowlisted bounded scalar summaries; never emit API keys, system tokens, management user IDs, environment values, URL query data, chat content, raw account responses, invoice rows or personal information. Original errors use safe {err} projection. Raw usage snapshots are separately filtered and capped at 32 KiB.
logging_integration.alerting: Reuse Publisher/outbox provider fingerprints, low-balance dedupe and two healthy passes. New policies default off. Failures never close incidents; notification delivery cannot affect business results. Reuse existing failure rules, without new log storage or automatic notifications during planning.
verification: Run pnpm lint:backend-logging and pnpm --filter @miniapp/backend logging:validate
Extend existing directory, generation, metadata, cost and balance-monitor tests; inspect actual Pino JSON allowlists and unchanged business outcomes
Verify request/trace/call/job correlation in TEST; no production success claim without real samples

planning_review.decision: User requested implementation on 2026-11-24; reuse Venice/OpenRouter adapter entry points; skip local UI tests. Existing risk-based regression and migration verification remain applicable.

remaining: Remote environment/source-hash collection and independent PG17/TEST migration
Real generation, invoice attribution and once-only billing
